BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

5. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

8. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

9. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   C. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.

12. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .

13. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

15. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   C. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money as rumours only.
   B. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
